title.narrative: To strengthen the strategic planning and institutional systems of HAT

description.narrative: This activity supports national and local civil society organisations (CSOs) working with older people through structured capacity assessments and organisational development planning. Each partner CSO undertakes a facilitated assessment to identify priority areas for strengthening, followed by tailored organisational development actions. The activity covers workshops, facilitation, learning resources and local partner participation, and is used to define long-term capacity strengthening support under the SCORE programme.
